response.original_title: A Haunting on the Saginaw River: The Gray Ghost
response.overview: Steve Shippy and the Haunted Saginaw crew are called in to investigate chilling claims of paranormal activity aboard a historic naval destroyer resting along the dark waters of the Saginaw River. For years, staff members and visitors from around the world have reported ghostly apparitions, unexplained shadows and strange phenomena moving through the ship’s cold, maze-like steel corridors.  As night falls and the vessel grows silent, Steve and his team venture deep into the heart of the massive destroyer, where decades of history seem to linger behind every hatch and passageway. Witness the shocking activity unfold as the investigators confront the unexplained aboard the legendary vessel known as The Gray Ghost.
